subject: pathology
title: c-ANCA and p-ANCA, Microscopic Polyangiitis, Churg-Strauss, and Buerger Disease

steps.tx: Cytoplasmic ANCA staining targets proteinase 3 and accompanies granulomatosis with polyangiitis, while perinuclear staining targets myeloperoxidase in microscopic polyangiitis and eosinophilic disease, patterns named by immunofluorescence. The cytoplasmic pattern is **c-ANCA (PR3-ANCA)**. This point is tested repeatedly because it changes everyday bedside decisions.
steps.say: c-ANCA means PR3 and GPA; p-ANCA means MPO and microscopic or eosinophilic polyangiitis, usually.

vis.alt: ANCA vasculitis clinical and histological features
vis.caption: ANCA associated small vessel vasculitis with pulmonary renal features.

steps.tx: Perinuclear ANCA also appears artefactually in inflammatory bowel disease, autoimmune hepatitis, and drug exposure including propylthiouracil and hydralazine, so antigen specificity and clinical pattern must agree before vasculitis is declared. That caution defines **p-ANCA (MPO-ANCA) interpretation**. Examiners return to it because it separates careful clinicians from guesswork.
steps.say: p-ANCA without MPO specificity or a vasculitis story is often bowel, liver, or drug noise.

right.title: ANCA noise
points: Atypical patterns, no MPO or PR3

steps.tx: Microscopic polyangiitis necrotises capillaries, venules, and arterioles without granulomas, presenting as rapidly progressive glomerulonephritis and pulmonary haemorrhage with MPO ANCA predominance. The pauci-immune renal emergency is **microscopic polyangiitis (MPA)**. Bedside recognition of this pattern saves time, blood, and unnecessary investigation.
steps.say: Pauci-immune crescentic nephritis plus lung haemorrhage without granulomas means microscopic polyangiitis.

vis.caption: Microscopic polyangiitis renal biopsy with crescentic glomerulonephritis.

steps.tx: Eosinophilic granulomatosis with polyangiitis, formerly Churg-Strauss, marches through adult asthma, blood and tissue eosinophilia, fleeting infiltrates, mononeuritis, and small vessel vasculitis, ANCA positive in a minority. The eosinophil rich disease is **EGPA (Churg-Strauss syndrome)**. Students should anchor this fact before moving to rarer causes and exceptions.
steps.say: Asthma plus eosinophilia plus mononeuritis multiplex spells EGPA, the old Churg-Strauss syndrome.

vis.caption: Eosinophilic granulomatosis with polyangiitis across lung, nerve, and skin.

steps.tx: Buerger disease, thromboangiitis obliterans, inflames and clots small and medium limb vessels of young heavy smokers, sparing vessel walls' architecture while causing migratory phlebitis, rest pain, and digital gangrene. Abstinence alone halts it: **Buerger disease (thromboangiitis obliterans)**. In practice this distinction decides the next test, treatment, or referral made.
steps.say: Young smoker, digital gangrene, migratory phlebitis: Buerger disease, and only abstinence stops its march.

rows: Small medium limb vessels, young smokers

steps.tx: Drug induced ANCA vasculitis from propylthiouracil, hydralazine, minocycline, or levamisole adulterated cocaine often carries dual MPO and PR3 positivity with higher titres, resolving substantially on drug withdrawal. Excavating exposures is **drug-induced ANCA vasculitis recognition**. That is why this detail earns its place in every examination and ward round.
steps.say: Dual PR3 and MPO positivity should excavate drug histories before immunosuppression escalates.

steps.tx: Kidney biopsy in ANCA disease shows pauci-immune crescentic glomerulonephritis, few immune deposits distinguishing it from lupus and anti-GBM disease, with Berden classes forecasting renal recovery. The scant deposit pattern is **pauci-immune crescentic glomerulonephritis**. Remembering it prevents the commonest errors made with this presentation entirely.
steps.say: Pauci-immune means almost no deposits; crescents plus ANCA separate it from lupus and anti-GBM nephritis.

steps.tx: Relapse vigilance in ANCA vasculitis follows symptoms, urine, creatinine, and inflammatory markers more faithfully than ANCA titres alone, because titre and activity divorce in both directions often enough to mislead. That monitoring discipline is **ANCA vasculitis relapse surveillance**. The clinical payoff comes from applying it early, before complications accumulate further.
steps.say: Treat the patient and urine, not the ANCA titre; titres accompany activity too loosely to steer alone.
